result.title: Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging
result.summary: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps. In practice the task vectors of different tasks interfere, and the standard remedies--averaging, magnitude pruning, sign election--operate entry by entry, ignoring that each delta induces a low-dimensional update on the hidden features it acts upon. We recast merging as a subspace interference problem. For every two-dimensional weight tensor we take the top-r right-singular subspace of each task's delta--the input directions along which that task moves the representation most--and remove from each task vector the component lying in the union of the other tasks' subspaces. The resulting Joint Null-Space Projection (JNSP) is closed-form and order-independent, needs no forward pass, and is defined entirely by the checkpoint set. On eight CLIP image-classification tasks JNSP merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average accuracy without using a single image, 11.88 points above the strongest parameter-wise training-free baseline (TIES-Merging, 77.57%), 14.22 above Task Arithmetic, and 0.98 above WUDI's data-free consensus merge (88.47%). The gain holds across three backbones on the independently trained TALL release (+10.8, +12.6, +9.1 over TIES for ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14) and replicates there at 89.20%; controls confirm the source--a single shared subspace instead of per-task ones loses 2.9 points, and a sequential variant collapses to 69.6%. On RoBERTa-large the same projection underperforms plain task arithmetic, which we report rather than hide. Code is available at https://github.com.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把无数据模型合并视为子空间干扰问题：对每个任务向量的权重增量取前 r 个右奇异子空间，从中剔除落在其他任务子空间并集内的分量，提出闭式、与顺序无关的 Joint Null-Space Projection，并在 CLIP 多任务与 RoBERTa 上检验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“低维子空间刻画权重更新、投影去除任务间干扰”的思路，可能为 LVR 中合并 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等专门化专家、或分析多任务增量在内部表示上的子空间冲突提供可核查线索；但该文不涉及推理期 latent 生成或视觉证据使用。
